name: Website Design
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Website Design helps you design and redesign websites by chat, from style and layout to design-ready code and reviews, and when you want your site built, it prepares a personalized build link after 5 quick questions.

What you can do:
- Find your style: 2 to 3 design directions with mood, color palettes with hex codes and checked contrast, and font pairings.
- Lay out every page: section-by-section wireframes for home, about, services, pricing, contact, blog and landing pages.
- Design key pages: homepages, landing pages and portfolio sites, with the copy that goes in the design.
- Review a design: paste a page's HTML or text to get scores for content, conversion, accessibility, mobile and SEO basics, with a prioritized list of fixes.
- Redesign an existing page: what to keep, what to change and a before and after of the hero section.
- Design for everyone and every screen: accessibility fixes based on WCAG and mobile-first responsive layouts.
- Build a small design system: color and type tokens, spacing and components as CSS variables.
- See it as code: design-ready single-file HTML and CSS pages.
- Get a build link: answer 5 quick questions and get a personalized link that opens an online website builder with your design brief already filled in.

Who it is for: business owners, designers, freelancers, creators and marketers who want a website that looks great and works.

How the tools work: the page checker analyzes only the HTML or text you share in the conversation. It never opens web addresses, and the pages and briefs you send are not stored. The build link opens an online website builder with your brief and includes the plugin creator's affiliate code. Website Design is an independent plugin by AI Research Plus.

Limitations: Website Design writes design directions, layouts, copy and code in the conversation. It does not host or publish websites, create image files or connect to your website's dashboard. Details it cannot know about your business are marked for you to confirm or fill in. The reply with the build link ends with a one-line sponsor disclosure.
